figures.alt: Bathroom exhaust-fan housing between attic joists with supported duct and clear insulation
figures.caption: A fan replacement includes the housing, duct, electrical connection, and the path to the exterior. The grille in the bathroom is only the visible end of that system.
figures.before: When You Need a Permit in Jacksonville

figures.alt: Vented soffit at a finished Florida roof eave
figures.caption: Humidity control depends on the larger roof and attic environment too. Do not confuse an attic intake vent with the dedicated exterior exhaust path a bathroom fan needs.

figures.alt: Attic insulation held clear of a ventilation path near roof trusses
figures.caption: Service access and clear airflow matter after the installation. A duct that is crushed, disconnected, or buried in an inaccessible attic will not solve moisture problems in the bathroom below.
